verses.sloka: रामः अपि रात्रि शेषेण तेन एव महद् अन्तरम् ।जगाम पुरुष व्याघ्रः पितुर् आज्ञाम् अनुस्मरन् ॥२-४९-१॥
verses.transliteration: rāmaḥ api rātri śeṣeṇa tena eva mahad antaram ।jagāma puruṣa vyāghraḥ pitur ājñām anusmaran ॥2-49-1॥

translations.english: Recollecting his father's command, Rama, the foremost among men, covered a long distance during the remaining part of the night.

verses.sloka: तथैव गच्चतः तस्य व्यपायात् रजनी शिवा ।उपास्य स शिवाम् सम्ध्याम् विषय अन्तम् व्यगाहत ॥२-४९-२॥
verses.transliteration: tathaiva gaccataḥ tasya vyapāyāt rajanī śivā ।upāsya sa śivām samdhyām viṣaya antam vyagāhata ॥2-49-2॥

translations.english: While Rama was thus travelling, the auspicious night ended. With the sandhya (morning twilight), worship over, he reached the frontiers of the country.
translations.hindi: जब वे श्रीरामचन्द्र को वन भेज कर आए, तब वे बड़े खिन्न आर मृतप्राय हो गए थे

verses.sloka: ग्रामान् विकृष्ट सीमान् तान् पुष्पितानि वनानि च ।पश्यन्न् अतिययौ शीघ्रम् शरैः इव हय उत्तमैः ॥२-४९-३॥
verses.transliteration: grāmān vikṛṣṭa sīmān tān puṣpitāni vanāni ca ।paśyann atiyayau śīghram śaraiḥ iva haya uttamaiḥ ॥2-49-3॥

translations.english: Watching the villages furrowed at the outskirts, forests in blossom, hearing the gossips of the people living in the midst of villages, Rama felt he was moving very slowly whereas he had actually covered a long distance with those excellent (swift) horses.

verses.sloka: शृण्वन् वाचो मनुष्याणाम् ग्राम सम्वास वासिनाम् ।राजानम् धिग् दशरथम् कामस्य वशम् आगतम् ॥२-४९-४॥
verses.transliteration: śṛṇvan vāco manuṣyāṇām grāma samvāsa vāsinām ।rājānam dhig daśaratham kāmasya vaśam āgatam ॥2-49-4॥

translations.english: (The villagers were speaking among themselves) Fie on the king who is overtaken by passion Alas, the heartless, sinful Kaikeyi, indulging in evil has banished into the forest this prince who is righteous and sagacious, compassionate and selfrestrained. How could this cruel Kaikeyi, by breaking all limits of decorum resort to such atrocious action?
translations.hindi: उस समय पुरबासियों में न तो कोई प्रसन्न और न कोई अमो- . {दित होता था । बनियों ने अपनी दूकाने बंद कर रखी थीं | अथात्‌. १ सत्त्वानि -प्राणाः । २ पुण्यानि-पुण्यफलभूतपुत्रकलत्रादीनि | Me र 2 १7" त्र = हि Es री छ म के ] | बाजार बंद था। घरों में किसी ने न तो अपने लड़के-लड़कियों को सजाया और न स्त्रिया ने अपना श्वङ्घार किया । यहाँ तक क्रि, गृहस्थों के घर चूल्हा ही न जला अथीत्‌ रसोई न हुई--सब लोग भूखे प्यासे रहे

verses.sloka: हा नृशम्स अद्य कैकेयी पापा पाप अनुबन्धिनी ।तीक्ष्णा सम्भिन्न मर्यादा तीक्ष्णे कर्मणि वर्तते ॥२-४९-५॥
verses.transliteration: hā nṛśamsa adya kaikeyī pāpā pāpa anubandhinī ।tīkṣṇā sambhinna maryādā tīkṣṇe karmaṇi vartate ॥2-49-5॥

translations.english: (The villagers were speaking among themselves) Fie on the king who is overtaken by passion Alas, the heartless, sinful Kaikeyi, indulging in evil has banished into the forest this prince who is righteous and sagacious, compassionate and selfrestrained. How could this cruel Kaikeyi, by breaking all limits of decorum resort to such atrocious action?

verses.sloka: या पुत्रम् ईदृशम् राज्ञः प्रवासयति धार्मिकम् ।वन वासे महा प्राज्ञम् सानुक्रोशम् अतन्द्रितम् ॥२-४९-६॥
verses.transliteration: yā putram īdṛśam rājñaḥ pravāsayati dhārmikam ।vana vāse mahā prājñam sānukrośam atandritam ॥2-49-6॥

translations.english: (The villagers were speaking among themselves) Fie on the king who is overtaken by passion Alas, the heartless, sinful Kaikeyi, indulging in evil has banished into the forest this prince who is righteous and sagacious, compassionate and selfrestrained. How could this cruel Kaikeyi, by breaking all limits of decorum resort to such atrocious action?
translations.hindi: न तो कोई अपने नष्ट हुए धन को पा कर और न कोई विपुल धन पा कर ही हर्षित होता था । अ्येष्ठपुत्र को पा कर माता प्रसन्न न होती थी ॥%॥ गृहे ग्रृहे रुदन्त्यश्च भतार ग्रृहमागतम्‌। ९ (4 NN व्यगहयन्त दुःखाता वागिभिस्तोत्र रिव द्विपान्‌

verses.sloka: कथम् नाम महाभागा सीता जनकनन्दिनी ।सदा सुखेष्वभिरता दुःखान्यनुभविष्यति ॥२-४९-७॥
verses.transliteration: katham nāma mahābhāgā sītā janakanandinī ।sadā sukheṣvabhiratā duḥkhānyanubhaviṣyati ॥2-49-7॥

translations.english: How will Sita, highly fortunate daughter of Janaka and used to comforts endure these sufferings?

verses.sloka: अहो दशरथो राजा निस्नेहः स्वसुत प्रियम् ।प्रजानामनघम् रामम् परित्यक्तुमिहेच्छति ॥२-४९-८॥
verses.transliteration: aho daśaratho rājā nisnehaḥ svasuta priyam ।prajānāmanagham rāmam parityaktumihecchati ॥2-49-8॥

translations.english: Alas, the loveless king Dasaratha now intends to abandon his own sinless son Rama who is dear to the subjects.
translations.hindi: सब पुरबासी यही कह रहे थे कि जब वे लोग श्रीराम चन्द्र : जी ही को नहीं देख .पांते, तब उन्हे घर, स्त्री, धन, दौलत, पुत्र ` अथवा सुख का प्रयोजन ही क्या है ॥७) FEE > वि एक; सत्पुरुषो लोके लक्ष्मणः सह सीतया । ` योड्युगच्छति काकुत्स्थं रामं परिचरन्‌ वने

verses.sloka: एता वाचो मनुष्याणाम् ग्राम सम्वास वासिनाम् ।शृण्वन्न् अति ययौ वीरः कोसलान् कोसल ईश्वरः ॥२-४९-९॥
verses.transliteration: etā vāco manuṣyāṇām grāma samvāsa vāsinām ।śṛṇvann ati yayau vīraḥ kosalān kosala īśvaraḥ ॥2-49-9॥

translations.english: Such were the words of people living in villages and hamlets that Rama the valiant lord of Kosala happened to hear as he was crossing the boundaries of Kosala.

verses.sloka: ततः वेद श्रुतिम् नाम शिव वारि वहाम् नदीम् ।उत्तीर्य अभिमुखः प्रायात् अगस्त्य अध्युषिताम् दिशम् ॥२-४९-१०॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ veda śrutim nāma śiva vāri vahām nadīm ।uttīrya abhimukhaḥ prāyāt agastya adhyuṣitām diśam ॥2-49-10॥

translations.english: He then crossed the river Vedasruti flowing with sacred waters and went in the southern direction where sage Agastya resided.
translations.hindi: रमणीय बन सुन्दर तट वाली नदियाँ और सुन्दर शिखर बाले पवत काकुत्स्थ श्रीरामचन्द्र जी की शोमा बढ़ाबंगे

verses.sloka: गत्वा तु सुचिरम् कालम् ततः शीत जलाम् नदीम् ।गोमतीम् गोयुत अनूपाम् अतरत् सागरम् गमाम् ॥२-४९-११॥
verses.transliteration: gatvā tu suciram kālam tataḥ śīta jalām nadīm ।gomatīm goyuta anūpām atarat sāgaram gamām ॥2-49-11॥

translations.english: Travelling for a long time along the river Gomati full of cool waters on whose marshy bank cows grazed, Rama crossed it at the point where it flows into the sea.

verses.sloka: गोमतीम् च अपि अतिक्रम्य राघवः शीघ्रगैः हयैः ।मयूर हम्स अभिरुताम् ततार स्यन्दिकाम् नदीम् ॥२-४९-१२॥
verses.transliteration: gomatīm ca api atikramya rāghavaḥ śīghragaiḥ hayaiḥ ।mayūra hamsa abhirutām tatāra syandikām nadīm ॥2-49-12॥

translations.english: Gomati gone, Rama with the swiftmoving horses crossed the river Syandika echoing with the cries of peacocks and swans.
translations.hindi: चे पेड़ भी, जिनकी फुनगियाँ फूलों से शोभित हैं और अनेक मंजरी घारणकिए हुए हें घोर जिन पर भोरे गुंजार कर रहे हँ, ' _ अपना सुन्दर स्वरूप श्रीरामचन्द्र को दिखलाबेगे

verses.sloka: स महीम् मनुना राज्ञा दत्ताम् इक्ष्वाकवे पुरा ।स्फीताम् राष्ट्र आवृताम् रामः वैदेहीम् अन्वदर्शयत् ॥२-४९-१३॥
verses.transliteration: sa mahīm manunā rājñā dattām ikṣvākave purā ।sphītām rāṣṭra āvṛtām rāmaḥ vaidehīm anvadarśayat ॥2-49-13॥

translations.english: Rama showed Sita vast tracts of land encircled by kingdoms which were formerly bestowed upon Ikshvaku by emperor Manu.

verses.sloka: सूतैति एव च आभाष्य सारथिम् तम् अभीक्ष्णशः ।हम्स मत्त स्वरः श्रीमान् उवाच पुरुष ऋषभः ॥२-४९-१४॥
verses.transliteration: sūtaiti eva ca ābhāṣya sārathim tam abhīkṣṇaśaḥ ।hamsa matta svaraḥ śrīmān uvāca puruṣa ṛṣabhaḥ ॥2-49-14॥

translations.english: Graceful Rama, best among men with a voice resembling that of an intoxicated swan, called the charioteer again and again and said:
translations.hindi: पहाड़ों पर के पेड़ श्रीरामचन्द्र जी का मनोरञ्जन करगे | जहाँ श्रीरामचन्द्र जी होंगे बहा न तो उनको किसी का भय ही होगा ऋोर न उनकी कभी हार ही होगी

verses.sloka: कदा अहम् पुनर् आगम्य सरय्वाः पुष्पिते वने ।मृगयाम् पर्याटष्यामि मात्रा पित्रा च सम्गतः ॥२-४९-१५॥
verses.transliteration: kadā aham punar āgamya sarayvāḥ puṣpite vane ।mṛgayām paryāṭaṣyāmi mātrā pitrā ca samgataḥ ॥2-49-15॥

translations.english: When shall I return and reunite with my father and mother and go hunting in the blooming forest on the bank of the river Sarayu?

verses.sloka: न अत्यर्थम् अभिकान्क्षामि मृगयाम् सरयू वने ।रतिर् हि एषा अतुला लोके राज ऋषि गण सम्मता ॥२-४९-१६॥
verses.transliteration: na atyartham abhikānkṣāmi mṛgayām sarayū vane ।ratir hi eṣā atulā loke rāja ṛṣi gaṇa sammatā ॥2-49-16॥

translations.english: In this world, hunting is a unique pleasure. It is regarded as a delightful sport for royal sages. But I do not have a great longing for hunting in the forest on the bank of river Sarayu.
translations.hindi: ये महाबाहु ओर शूर दशरथनन्दन अभी बहुत दूर नहीं गये होगे, अत: चलो हम सब श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के पास चल

verses.sloka: राजर्षीणाम् हि लोकेऽस्मिन् रत्यर्थम् मृगया वने ।काले कृताम् ताम् मनुजैर्धन्विनामभिकाङ्क्षिताम् ॥२-४९-१७॥
verses.transliteration: rājarṣīṇām hi loke'smin ratyartham mṛgayā vane ।kāle kṛtām tām manujairdhanvināmabhikāṅkṣitām ॥2-49-17॥

translations.english: In this world, hunting in the woods is a pleasure for royal sages and is greatly sought after by bowmen. This was later resorted to by others.
translations.hindi: अनुक्रोशात्‌ु-आदरात्‌ । ( गो० ) २ पादच्छायेति--पादसेवा ` लक्ष्यते । (गो० ) ३ परायणम्‌-परमयनं+ सवप्रकारेण श्राधारभूत इत्यथ: | (गो०) बा० रा० अ०--३२ है + ४६८ आयोध्याकाणडे क्योंकि वैसे महात्मा और स्वामी की चरणसेवा भी हमको सुख देगी । वे ही इस अखिल संसार के स्वामी, गति ओर आधारः हैं

verses.sloka: स तम् अध्वानम् ऐक्ष्वाकः सूतम् मधुरया गिरातम् तम् अर्थम् अभिप्रेत्य ययौवाक्यम् उदीरयन् ॥२-४९-१८॥
verses.transliteration: sa tam adhvānam aikṣvākaḥ sūtam madhurayā girātam tam artham abhipretya yayauvākyam udīrayan ॥2-49-18॥

translations.english: The descendant of Ikshvaku related to the charioteer in a sweet voice the thoughts that came to him and went on the way (continued his journey). इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे एकोनपञ्चाशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortyninth sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
